title: Product of binary sign characters
statement: For any $a,\gamma\in(\mathbb F_2)^n$, define the sign character associated with $u\in(\mathbb F_2)^n$ by $z\mapsto(-1)^{\langle u,z\rangle}$, where the dot product is taken in $\mathbb F_2$. Multiplying the character for $\gamma$ pointwise by the character for $a$ gives the character for $\gamma+a$.
